lt.line: O jis atsakė: „Mano motina ir mano broliai – tai tie, kurie klausosi Dievo žodžio ir jį vykdo“.

en.event: Tuesday of the Twenty-fifth Week in Ordinary Time
en.line: He was told, “Your mother and your brothers are standing outside and they wish to see you.” He said to them in reply, “My mother and my brothers are those who hear the word of God
